ADD-03/2.1.old: as set out in the agreed Financial Model at Financial Close
ADD-03/2.1.new: as stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees

ADD-03/2.2.note: The definition in VOL-V 1.3 as amended by ADD-03 Section 2.1 applies wherever 'Estimated Project Cost' is used in the RFP Documents (incl. VOL-I 8.4 as amended, VOL-V 18.1/18.4, Form 4-F).

ADD-03/3.1.new: twenty-five per cent (25%) of the Estimated Project Cost

ADD-03/4.1.old: SAR 180,000 for each day of delay
ADD-03/4.1.new: one-twentieth of one per cent (0.05%) of the Estimated Project Cost for each day of delay

ADD-03/S6/para1(b).old: sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial
ADD-03/S6/para1(b).new: seventy per cent (70%) technical and thirty per cent (30%) commercial

ADD-03/S6/para1(c).note: Note (3): marks awarded on the Authority's standard five-point scale and multiplied by the weight shown (same wording as ADD-02 Note (3)).

ADD-03/6.2(a).old: A Proposal scoring less than seventy (70) marks out of one hundred (100) at the technical evaluation shall not proceed to commercial evaluation and its Envelope B shall be returned unopened.
ADD-03/6.2(a).new: A Proposal whose technical score is less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1 shall not proceed to commercial evaluation.

ADD-03/6.2(b).new_text: The Envelope B of a Proposal that does not proceed to commercial evaluation shall be retained unopened by the Authority and returned to the Bidder after the Preferred Bidder Notification.

ADD-03/8.4.note: Failure to submit a complete and properly executed Form 4-H for each member by the time required by Section 8.3 renders the Proposal non-responsive.

ADD-03/Q15.note: Q15: the PCG must be unlimited as to the guaranteed obligations and not conditional on prior demand on the EPC Contractor; a guarantee capped at a fixed amount is not accepted. Consistent with Form 4-D as issued (limit of liability; item 3).

ADD-03/Q16.note: Q16: the Estimated Project Cost in Form 4-F includes grid connection works only if ADD-03 Section 7 has effect; otherwise the Authority provides the grid connection point under VOL-II 1.4.

ADD-03/Q18.note: Q18: the maximum velocity in VOL-II 5.2 (as amended by ADD-03 Section 5.1) applies to the whole transmission main including the trenchless crossings under VOL-II 5.4.

ADD-03/Q19.note: Q19: the Authority notes the question how 8.4(a) as amended is shown in Envelope A when the Estimated Project Cost is only in Form 4-F (Envelope B); it cites VOL-I 6.2 and 11.1 and makes no further amendment. Open issue.

ADD-03/Q20.note: Q20: the certified copy of the register of shareholders attached to Form 4-H (Third declaration) need not be legalised, including for members incorporated outside the Kingdom.
